strategy.summary: Shoot a standup target or the captive ball, then shoot the raised wall scoop to collect the offered item. Every shot displays its point value; Multiball keeps those values and has no Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Collect an item
quickInfo.summary: Hit any one of the four standup targets or the captive ball, then shoot the randomly raised wall scoop to collect the item.

quickInfo.name: Visible shot values
quickInfo.summary: Every shot displays its point value, which changes with the configured number of balls.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Some items lock balls or start an instant Multiball, which has no Jackpots or Super Jackpots and keeps the normal shot values active.

steps.text: Hit any one of the four standup targets or the captive ball. One wall scoop rises at random.
Shoot the raised wall scoop to collect the offered item. Each item can help, hinder, change scoring, lock balls, or start an instant Multiball.
Read the point value displayed at each shot. Making that shot scores the displayed value.
If an item starts Multiball, continue shooting the displayed values. There are no Jackpots or Super Jackpots.

cautions.issue: Not every item helps the player.
cautions.response: Watch the display and visible playfield changes after every item collect; an item's effect is not guaranteed to be beneficial.

cautions.issue: The game has no tilt warnings.
cautions.response: Nudge cautiously because a tilt ends the game.

strategy.simpleOverview: Ranger in the Ruins is an item-collection game. Hit one of the four standup targets or the captive ball to raise a random wall scoop, then shoot that scoop to collect its item. If an item starts Multiball, keep shooting the displayed values because Multiball does not add Jackpots.
